record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: If a Banach lattice algebra has an approximate identity \((e_\gamma )\) with all \(\Vert e_\gamma \Vert \le 1\) , must it have an approximate identity composed of positive elements?

evidence.quote: If a Banach lattice algebra has an approximate identity \((e_\gamma )\) with all \(\Vert e_\gamma \Vert \le 1\) , must it have an approximate identity composed of positive elements?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Banach lattice algebra is a real Banach lattice $(A,\|\cdot\|,\le)$ that is also an associative algebra whose norm is submultiplicative (i.e. $\|ab\|\le\|a\|\,\|b\|$ for all $a,b\in A$) and in which the product of any two positive elements is positive (i.e. if $a,b\ge 0$ then $ab\ge 0$). A net $(e_\gamma)_{\gamma\in\Gamma}$ in $A$ is called an approximate identity if $\lim_\gamma \|e_\gamma a - a\| = 0$ and $\lim_\gamma \|a e_\gamma - a\| = 0$ for every $a\in A$. It is contractive if $\|e_\gamma\|\le 1$ for every $\gamma$, and positive if $e_\gamma\ge 0$ for every $\gamma$.

Question: Suppose a Banach lattice algebra $A$ admits a contractive approximate identity (i.e. an approximate identity $(e_\gamma)$ with $\|e_\gamma\|\le 1$ for all $\gamma$). Must $A$ then admit an approximate identity consisting of positive elements?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the literature on Banach lattice algebras (notably in Wickstead's survey of questions on Banach lattice algebras and in subsequent surveys on ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms). No published resolution was located in the search; recent work on Banach lattice AM-algebras and related topics continues to treat the existence of positive approximate identities as an outstanding issue.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattice algebras: some questions, but very few answers
status_evidence.snippet: Wickstead poses the question of a positive approximate identity's existence in a Banach lattice algebra with an arbitrary bounded approximate identity.
status_evidence.claim: The question is explicitly stated as an open problem about Banach lattice algebras.

status_evidence.snippet: Survey article listing open problems including this one on positive approximate identities.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed among open problems in a 2017 survey.
